items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee confirms being interviewed by Ben Sidran ('Oh yeah, that was my first recital as a singer') and discusses topics covered in that interview, but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Ben Sidran beyond the interviewer-interviewee dynamic.

ctx.x: Ok. So you, there’s, I had in my research, looked at or gone through some of the prior interviews, and of course one particular one with Ben Sidran, that talked about your pre-teen days. And also looking at your inclination for music. And, tell us about that, ‘cause this is something that I think is very interesting to see at a young age that you already had the passion, or at least an interest in it.
Well my father was a piano teacher, so I learned to play as I learned to walk, you know. It’s just so natural. My mother was also a musician, and gave me piano lessons.
